json.title: Database commit() called without await
json.reason: A promise-returning API (db.commit()) is invoked as a bare expression statement, so its completion or rejection is never awaited — a syntactically detectable floating-promise bug that can recur anywhere commit() is called.
json.message: `commit()` is called without `await`: the transaction may fail or settle after the function returns.
json.note: db.commit() returns a promise; calling it as a bare statement lets the enclosing async function return (and the response be sent) before the commit settles, silently dropping writes when it rejects. Prefix it with `await` (or `return` the promise) so failures propagate.
json.rule_yaml:
rule:
  all:
    - kind: call_expression
    - pattern: $DB.commit($$$ARGS)
    - inside:
        kind: expression_statement
